messages:
claire (AE): New RFI from Meridian Health. They want a 2-week POC: private deployment in their VPC, customer HSM (PKCS#11), 7yr audit retention, embeddings ~80 QPS and gen ~30 QPS. Also asked for a capability matrix + quick cost estimate. Need draft by EOD tomorrow.
noah (Sales Eng): Got it. Quick clarifiers: preferred region? embedding/gen token lengths? Are they ok with a Redwood-managed HSM fallback for the first few days?
claire (AE): Region: us-east-1. Embeddings seq ~512, gen avg 220 tokens. They prefer BYOH but said fallback is acceptable for initial validation. Procurement wants a one-page summary for legal.
anya (Solutions): I'll create the capability matrix mapping their asks to our features: BYOH PKCS#11 support, Redwood-managed HSM fallback, VPC peering options, audit retention options, and performance caveats. Will attach the BYOH playbook and a sample deployment snippet.
marco (SRE): Notes for the RFI: PKCS#11 over peered network adds ~5-15ms per key op depending on network. For throughput target recommend 3x A10x with workload-aware batching for embeddings. Peering provisioning often takes 24-48hrs. Audit retention 7yrs supported but storage/TCO needs separate line item. We should include a small test plan to validate HSM ops/sec and p95 gen latency at 220 tokens.
ops-bot: playbook-uploaded: "byoh-hsm-playbook-v4.pdf" to /internal/playbooks (link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byoh-hsm-playbook-v4)
noah (Sales Eng): Preliminary POC pricing (placeholder): 3 GPUs x 2 weeks = $13,500; peering/onboarding = $2,000; SE support (2 days) = $3,000; audit storage delta ~$130/mo. I'll refine once matrix + seqs confirmed.
anya (Solutions): Draft matrix ETA 3 hours. Example config snippet I'll include in attachments:
```
deployment:
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.10.5.7:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555  # ~7 years
```
marco (SRE): I'll add the test-plan items: validate HSM key ops/sec (target 200 ops/sec headroom), measure p95 gen latency at 220 tokens, validate embeddings QPS at 80 under load, and confirm audit log delivery/retention lifecycle. Also document fallback to Redwood-managed HSM and the operational differences.
claire (AE): Perfect. Please tag me when the draft is in /sales/meridian/rfi-draft. Procurement wants the one-pager by tomorrow noon. Thanks team :pray:
